text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The once-a-year Christmas. Tearing through 
the streets like the wind, it 
approaches... *That* thing.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ngah! Who was the one who unreasonably 
told me to "come in through the chimney"?! 
It's so tight in here~~~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Geh, the bag is stuck. If it's come to 
this, I'll just have to force it a bit...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: It broke! But I slipped through!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Uhyohyohyo, that's right! Hand over your 
valuables...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Wait, why do you ask? Today is Christmas, 
you know? To tell the truth, I...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"It's Machikane Santakitaru! I've come to 
deliver presents to all the good 
children!"
choice_data_list:
Sorry. Could you say your name one more 
time?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Gah! That's harsh~. Now you're making it 
seem like my joke totally fell flat~.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Now, more importantly, the presents. Put 
your hand in the bag and draw whichever 
one you like.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
My present is lottery-style! You get 
whatever you draw, okay~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I reached inside and randomly drew one 
out...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that fortune is... Great Blessing~!! 
Congratulations! Anyone who gets Great 
Blessing gets to keep the slip as a 
present!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ayaya, are you dissatisfied? It cannot be 
helped, I suppose. Here, take this 
instead.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ta-daaa! Inside the box is a 
thousand-year-old Christmas tree 
(miniature)!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: This is a good one. Go on, open it up!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unwrapping the packaging and opening the 
box...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Wait, oh no!? The star on my head is...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The ornament was snapped clean in two. It 
seems it broke when it got caught on 
something just now.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh, I'm sorry~ I'm such a clumsy 
Santa...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Um, Trainer. Could you come outside with 
me for a moment...?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me~. Shopkeeper, can I get some 
glue and tape, please~?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I shall repair it, so please give me a 
moment. Ugh, how utterly embarrassing...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, I wanted to celebrate in a more 
sacred, dignified manner. How pathetic of 
me...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Trainer...! *sniff*, you're so kind!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Since you're being so kind, could I ask 
one more thing...? When we get back, would 
you help me put on the stars?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
We can do it after we eat the cake. 
Ehehehe...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the end, we spent the time doing crafts 
together. It turned out to be a strangely 
heartwarming Christmas.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case, it's time for our 
secret weapon! Here, Trainer, hold the 
tree up toward the sky.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Doesn't it look like it's adorned with 
real stars? How romantic!"
choice_data_list: I hope it's a real, proper star.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Gasp! Real Star wasn't good enough? I 
squeezed out every ounce of romance I 
didn't even have, though.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I really should reattach the star 
that fell off after all... Sigh...
choice_data_list:
Let's crown it with a victory at the 
"Arima Kinen".

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? Do you mean the Arima Kinen... 
that's about to start?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, what a move! You got me. That was so 
cool. I really underestimated you~.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Trainer... Y-Yes... Anything... Um...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
You're looking awfully dressed up today, 
Trainer. Looking at you makes my heart 
race a bit...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"I feel like I'm gonna turn into 
Matikanespringhascome. I mean, it's 
winter, but did that joke really land?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The star meant for the top of the tree 
isn't here yet. Let's go claim that final 
star.
